patch.summary: AdCreative.ai migration guide: inventory → rehearse → freeze → validate integrations — grounded in researched limitations and catalogue peers.

blocks.body: Migrate to AdCreative.ai by inventorying legacy ai fields, mapping them to AdCreative.ai objects, rehearsing a freeze window, and validating Facebook Ads, Google Ads before reopening writes.
bullets: Inventory → map → rehearse → cut over → reopen
Highest risk: Starter list price is a higher entry floor than presentation tools like Gamma
Success signal: LLM chat and assistants works for the pilot cohort

blocks.heading: AdCreative.ai migration cutover playbook
blocks.body: Migrations fail from optimistic timelines — not from missing motivation.

scenarios.title: Field inventory
scenarios.body: Export legacy fields that power LLM chat and assistants, writing and paraphrasing, image generation and mark must-map vs archive.

scenarios.title: Rehearsal load
scenarios.body: Run a non-prod load into AdCreative.ai; measure match rates before the freeze.

scenarios.title: Production freeze
scenarios.body: Freeze legacy writes; cut over; validate Facebook Ads; then reopen.

steps.label: Migrate when Paid media teams and agencies generating ad variants at scale outweigh migration cost
Delay if this limitation hits cutover: Starter list price is a higher entry floor than presentation tools like Gamma
If AdCreative.ai mapping is poor, compare destination fit with Gamma before moving data twice

items.title: No freeze window
items.body: Dual-writing without a freeze creates irrevocable duplicates.

items.title: Integrations last
items.body: Wire Facebook Ads in rehearsal — not on Monday morning after cutover.

items.title: Data risk 1
items.body: Starter list price is a higher entry floor than presentation tools like Gamma

items.title: Data risk 2
items.body: Credit-based creative generation — heavy campaigns raise TCO

items.title: Data risk 3
items.body: Not a general LLM assistant or full marketing automation suite

checklist.label: Complete field inventory for LLM chat and assistants
Mitigate: Starter list price is a higher entry floor than presentation tools like Gamma
